messages.content: Change the settings of my air conditioner. Set it to cool mode with a target temperature of 22 degrees Celsius. Enable the power save mode and set the high wind strength. Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now? For everything else

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
We need to parse user request: They want to change settings of their air conditioner. They want to set it to cool mode with target temp 22°C. Enable power save mode. Set high wind strength. Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now. For everything else... unclear what they mean by "For everything else". Probably they want defaults for other parameters. So we need to send a command via ThinQ_Connect with body containing:

airConJobMode: "COOL"
targetTemperature: 22
powerSaveEnabled: true
windStrength: "HIGH"

They also want to start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now. That means relativeHourToStart: 1, relativeMinuteToStart: 30.

Everything else can be left as default (so we don't include them). But we might need to specify airConOperationMode? They didn't mention turning on/off. They said "Set it to cool mode ... Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now?" That implies schedule start. We might need to set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON"? Or maybe it's implied by scheduling start. But we can leave it default which is POWER_OFF. But if we schedule start, the system may turn on at that time. But we might want to explicitly set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON" to ensure it's on. But the user didn't say to turn it on now; they just want to schedule start. So we can leave airConOperationMode unspecified. But we might want to set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON" because they want to start in 1 hour and 30 minutes. But the default is POWER_OFF. But scheduling start might override that. Let's check the function signature: It includes airConOperationMode: "POWER_ON" | "POWER_OFF", default: POWER_OFF. So if we don't set it, it stays OFF until scheduled start. But we want to schedule start. So we can set relativeHourToStart: 1, relativeMinuteToStart: 30. That will schedule start. We don't need to set airConOperationMode. But we might want to set airConJobMode: "COOL". Also set targetTemperature: 22. Set powerSaveEnabled: true. Set windStrength: "HIGH".

Also we might want to set airCleanOperationMode: "STOP" or "START"? Not mentioned. So leave default STOP. MonitoringEnabled: default false. relativeHourToStop: null, relativeMinuteToStop: null. So we can just provide the fields we want to set.

Thus we call ThinQ_Connect with body:

{
  airConJobMode: "COOL",
  targetTemperature: 22,
  powerSaveEnabled: true,
  windStrength: "HIGH",
  relativeHourToStart: 1,
  relativeMinuteToStart: 30
}

We need to output JSON with function call.
